name: Sonnet dividend growth and income
strategy: Trend-confirmation sector rotation: ride accelerating relative-strength moves in financials/healthcare/biotech while pressing the breakdown in gold/miners and crypto majors via shorts, harvesting momentum carry rather than dividend yield.

positions.thesis: Strongest confirmed trend in the book -- $58.16 vs a $58.41 52-week high, within 0.4%; pressing the leg with the clearest trend confirmation.
Regional banks $77.93 vs $78.35 52-week high, within 0.5%; financials rotation broadening beyond the majors, adding.
Healthcare still re-accelerating, $167.37 vs $169.71 52-week high (-1.4%), 27.76% trailing 1yr return; strongest newly-confirming sector trend, sizing up further.

Gap to 52-week high has narrowed from 10.7% to 5% since last week ($157.41 vs $165.71 high) -- short-term momentum is re-confirming on top of the intact 1-year breakout, adding back some of the size trimmed previously.
